visualReview.notes: Actually inspected all13 final portable views, eight architectural cameras and all51 final frame contacts. Compared with eight individually viewed local originals: current2025 southeast aerial;2007 roof;2012 northwest panorama; five2013 entry/keep/stair/enclosure/roof detail photos. All40 candidate contacts reviewed. Current aerial and owner visitor plan control connected layout, open courtyard, eight large body towers and separate roof pavilions. Six restored roof lanterns remain distinct from the56m central stone lantern. Three body storeys, small intermediate lights, crossed glazing, two arched main-keep doors/steps, upper open keep gallery bays, linking arcades, dormers and decorated chimney stacks. Both exterior stairs have actual treads, open shafts, arcade heads and rising stone parapets. Corrected gallery bays intruding into wings, pilasters crossing openings, missing main doors/thresholds, stair landing closures and paving clipping. Entry vault lining and a lower camera resolve the apparent initial closure: the original through-volume was already open.

limitations: Eight local originals individually inspected and all40 candidate contact views reviewed. Historical facade/plan engravings, interiors, Quebec, Montsoreau, Schwerin, Waddesdon and Zamosc do not control the current Chambord exterior.

Main connected château, keep/four drums, chapel/royal wings and two tall outer towers, low court enclosure/two flat front towers, current roof skyline and immediate thresholds only. Moats, formal gardens, bridges in the park, detached service buildings, interiors, trees, people, cars and flag cloth excluded.

Current2025 aerial controls overall massing and restored lantern finish. Earlier2007–2013 photos control visible stone/window details, not current lead polychromy or gilding. Original simplified abstract carving only, no literal heraldry or inscriptions.

Nominal156m frontage and56m central lantern height are owner controls. Native connected outline is approximately157.1×112.5m; preserve it rather than forcing a nominal bounding rectangle. Other heights and fine dimensions are map/photo estimates, not surveys.

Independent unchanged IGN provider terrain was acquired and verified before geometry. The 2m review grid and 0.01m response rounding do not establish effective native resolution or surveyed accuracy. Default coarse Terrarium compatibility is not certified; use a compatible host field. Footprint replacement disabled.

Four authored levels simplify small details: distant applied windows and reduced lantern/roof ornament; street exterior stairs use a helical ramp; close uses actual treads and open landing shafts. Balusters, stair arcade columns, crown tracery, chimney relief and thresholds are original proportional approximations, with no interior or engineering reconstruction.
Effective source resolution and surveyed accuracy are not specified by the API. Building/bridge areas may be interpolated in the terrain product.
Hydrographic surface levels are source-epoch values, not bathymetry, live water levels or engineering clearance.
Baseline Terrarium values contain large building/site returns and are preserved for comparison; independent official terrain is used for the site review.
